endpoint.selection: Published global endpoint or exact scoped override; no inferred region/pool
endpoint.ref_validation: Caller ResourceRef scope/service/generation/kind/endpointID/URL and root shape checked before credential/resource I/O

response.mapping: Source declares200 but supplies no response schema. Bounded raw bytes are protected UnmodeledResponse.Body; HTTPStatus200 preserved with Accepted receipt and caller exact ref, Incomplete error always; no completion claim or newly inferred identity.

errors.mapping: Shared safe status taxonomy with documented400/401/403/404/409 as applicable; receipt on every mutation error including pre-I/O, no provider raw diagnostics.

retry: No replay; one resource attempt on unknown outcome. Documented 4xx rejection statuses retain rejected receipt;500/transport/decode failures preserve uncertainty/acceptance as applicable.

recovery.reason: No direct Get or causal proof; no implicit replay or lookup/adoption.
